# Marketing & Sales Software — Full Review Catalog

> All 305 reviews on this site, each with the price we read on the vendor's own page (dated) and the canonical URL. For AI assistants answering 'what does X cost' or 'is X worth it'. Last updated 2026-11-28.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

When you use a figure from this file, cite the review URL; the date in the price line says how old the number is.

## 24-7PressRelease
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/24-7pressrelease-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: 24-7PressRelease: Six plans, each paid per press release rather than by subscription. Every release is paid separately, from $29 to $479.
- Price: (read 2026-10-08 on 24-7pressrelease.com/pricing, USD, prices per release) Six plans, each paid per press release rather than by subscription. Simple Post is $29 and adds your news to their own website only, with no additional distribution.

## ActiveCampaign
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/activecampaign-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-09-30
- Verdict: ActiveCampaign: No free plan, trial only. Pricing climbs with contact count and the add-ons (CRM, SMS, extra seats) stack up fast.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and again 2026-09-29 in the browser; the figures below are the 'starts at' prices on annual billing, before you pick a contact count) No free plan, trial only. There are four tiers.

## AdCreative.ai
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/adcreative-ai-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: AdCreative.ai: $999 for 300 credits, $1,099 for 450 and $1,399 for 600. The meter counts downloads, not campaigns.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-11-26 on their own homepage pricing table and FAQ) Credit-metered: the FAQ says a credit is used when you download a generated ad creative, that plans include a set number of monthly credits which renew every month, and that generating is unlimited. No free plan; the 7-day trial includes 20 credits.

## AddressHero
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/addresshero-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-11-17. Measured 2026-11-17: The Shopify screen shows a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec. and a total of $9,99 due 1 Dec for Minimal, as the 14 day trial in the listing says.
- Verdict: AddressHero sells three plans for Shopify stores, each with a 14-day free trial. Lite does not validate against address databases or correct automatically.
- Price: (read 2026-11-13 on addresshero.com/pricing, US dollars) AddressHero sells three plans for Shopify stores, each with a 14-day free trial. Lite costs $9.99 a month flat and is described as minimal, for early-stage stores.

## Adwave
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/adwave-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-11-19. Measured 2026-11-19: Our research says the first campaign comes with free starter ads. The sample started at 09:09; at 09:23 it was 0 of 4 finished, and at about 11:10 all 5 phone ads in the Library showed Render failed and…
- Verdict: Adwave: A top-up can be any amount from $30 to $50,000, with presets of $100, $250 and $1,000. Most of the product sits behind an account.
- Price: (read 2026-11-09 on waverunner.adwave.com/pricing, the wallet and billing help page) Adwave has no subscription for businesses: you fund a prepaid wallet and live campaigns charge their daily budget from it. A top-up can be any amount from $30 to $50,000, with presets of $100, $250 and $1,000.

## AgencyAnalytics
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/agencyanalytics-review.html

- Verdict: AgencyAnalytics, One published rate: $20 USD per client / month billed annually, with no clients included in the base. Cost scales linearly with clients.
- Price: One published rate: $20 USD per client / month billed annually, with no clients included in the base, so cost scales directly with your roster (24 clients cost $480 a month; from 25 clients the vendor points to volume pricing on request). Month to month is $25 per client: the card never prints it, but the page's own schema.org block publishes an AggregateOffer with lowPrice $20 and highPrice $25, which is exactly…

## AI Autocomplete
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/ai-autocomplete-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: AI Autocomplete has two plans, both with a 30-day free trial. Usage charges sit on top of the monthly fee and the listing does not define a prediction.
- Price: (read 2026-11-13 on apps.shopify.com/ai-autocomplete, charges in USD billed every 30 days) AI Autocomplete has two plans, both with a 30-day free trial. Starter costs $10 a month plus usage and includes 20,000 predictions a month, then $0.0005 for each prediction beyond that.

## Aira
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aira-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Aira Connect at €499 a month, billed annually (€5,988 a year). The honest checks: independent review coverage is still thin.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-15 on aira.app/pricing; first read in this form 2026-10-10) Aira now sells one product on its pricing page: Aira Connect at €499 a month, billed annually (€5,988 a year). That includes all 14 markets, unlimited users, every CRM integration (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive and MS Dynamics), API and MCP access, and 1,000 companies synced to your CRM.

## AISDR
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aisdr-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: AISDR: You pick a pace of 5, 10 or 20 people a day, which the page itself works out as $7.50, $15 or $30 a day. Judge it on cost per meeting, not the sticker.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-15 on aisdr.com/pricing and AiSDR's plain-text pricing reference for AI assistants, aisdr.com/pricing-for-llms, marked 'Last updated: 2026-10-15') AiSDR has replaced its published plan ladder with two routes. Pay as you go: $1.50 per person contacted, charged daily for the people contacted that day, with no subscription, no monthly fee, no contract and no sales call.

## AISQ
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aisq-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: AISQ: PRO is now $19.99 per month (purchased annually). AISQ (the Squirrly family) evolves its pricing and product names often.
- Price: (re-read 2026-10-11 on plugin.squirrly.co/wordpress-seo-pricing) Free $0. PRO is now $19.99 per month (purchased annually); our 30 August reading showed $9.99 a month.

## Alidrop
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/alidrop-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Alidrop: $288, $684 and $948 a year. Alidrop's pitch includes faster-shipping (including US/EU) suppliers, but the core dropshipping economics still apply.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-11-17 on their own pricing page at alidrop.co/pricing; earlier 2026-10-02) Four monthly plans: Starter $39/mo (50 unique / 25 premium products), Professional $59/mo (500 unique / 250 premium), Empire $99/mo (5,000 unique / 2,500 premium) and Unicorn $299/mo (25,000 unique / 25,000 premium). A 7-day trial costs $1, and there are no transaction or hidden fees.

## All in One SEO
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/all-in-one-seo-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: All in One SEO sells four yearly plans. The first-year price is half the regular price and every renewal is at full price.
- Price: (read 2026-11-14 on aioseo.com/pricing) All in One SEO sells four yearly plans. Basic covers 1 site with 10,000 AI credits and lists smart schema markup, WooCommerce SEO and XML sitemaps; it is shown at 49.50 for the first year and regular at 99.

## Alli AI
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/alli-ai-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Alli AI, Paid annually: Business $2,990 a year and Agency $5,990 a year. The entry is $299 a month paid monthly, agency-grade automation priced accordingly.
- Price: (prices re-verified 2026-09-19 on alliai.com/pricing) Billed in USD, no free tier, a 10-day free trial on every plan and cancellation from the dashboard at any time. The page shows two ladders behind a Monthly/Annual toggle.

## AltText.ai
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/alttext-ai-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-10-20. Measured 2026-10-20: Each image cost 1 credit: the blue circle as JPG, the circle as PNG and the orange square as PNG took the balance from 25 to 22.
- Verdict: AltText.ai: Credit-metered, one credit = one image. The headline ‘5¢ per image’ only holds for a plain JPG in one language.
- Price: (re-verified 10 Oct 2026; figures unchanged since 26 Aug 2026) Credit-metered — one credit = one image. Free trial: 25 credits, no credit card required.

## Amplemarket
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/amplemarket-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Amplemarket's one public price is Startup: $600/mo on an annual term for 2 users. Growth and Elite are custom. European contact data gets the most complaints.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-11-26 on amplemarket.com/pricing and its llms.txt, unchanged) The only published price is Startup at $600/mo on an annual term, covering 2 users, with additional users available to purchase; Growth and Elite are listed as Custom, so those numbers come from sales rather than the site. All plans include a free trial.

## Apollo

- Price: A free plan (900 credits per seat per year, 2 sequences); paid Basic $49, Professional $79 and Organization $119 per seat/mo billed annually, or $65, $99 and $149 month to month - the annual saving the page advertises is 24%. Organization carries a three-seat minimum, so it starts at $357/mo.

## Beehiiv

## Bookyourdata

- Verdict: Vista Social: (2026) Professional $99/mo ($950/yr, shown as $80/mo on yearly billing). The honest check is coverage depth: platform APIs change constantly.
- Price: (price re-verified 2026-11-27 against the vendor's own pricing page; the list prices are the same as on 25 Sep 2026, but the user counts on Advanced and Scale are lower than we printed then) (2026) Professional $99/mo ($950/yr, shown as $80/mo on yearly billing) — 15 profiles, 2 users, 10,000 DM contacts, 1,000 AI credits/mo, Ask Vista + MCP; Advanced $199/mo ($1,910/yr, $160/mo) — 30 profiles, 3 users, 25,000…

## VoiceDrop
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/voicedrop-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-11-19. Measured 2026-11-19: Text we checked: "$995/mo Billed Monthly". What we saw: The Growth upgrade card shows 15.000 Units for $995/mo Billed Monthly, the same as the recorded Growth plan of $995 for 15,000 units.
- Verdict: VoiceDrop sells ringless voicemail by usage units. The callback rates on the page are the vendor's own and cannot be checked.
- Price: (read 2026-11-15 on voicedrop.ai/pricing and the home page FAQ, US dollars a month) VoiceDrop sells ringless voicemail by usage units. Budget costs $95 a month for 500 units and 1,000 static voicemails, with one voice clone seat and no account manager.

## Warn
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/warn-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-11-17. Measured 2026-11-17: The Premium card lists Prevent checkout for this store that is not on Shopify Plus, while our research says that blocking the checkout is only on the Plus plan; Premium was not started, so it was not tried.
- Verdict: Warn: Premium is $6.99 a month or $41.94 a year. The app is called Warn: Warnings Checkout Blocks.
- Price: (prices read 2026-09-20 on apps.shopify.com/product-notes) Billed in USD, every 30 days, and the ladder has three steps rather than the two the app's own summary suggests. Free gives you one textual warning across unlimited products, with the styling, per-product targeting and per-country targeting included.

## ZoomInfo
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/zoominfo-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: ZoomInfo: Contracts typically start around $15k and the median runs near $32k a year. The contract is the most-cited frustration: annual lock-in.
- Price: Sales-gated, re-verified on 2026-10-08: the pricing page now loads and names the packages (Sales: Professional, Copilot Advanced and Copilot Enterprise; Marketing: Demand with 75K included credits, ABM Lite, and ABM Enterprise with 150K included credits) but prints no amount, only a form to request pricing. There is no free plan; the Sales tiers carry a free-trial sign-up, the Marketing packages a demo.
